scope_gaps.note: The item says German panel data; the stored abstract names no country or dataset.
The abstract reports a systematic association between longer commuting time and lower reported subjective well-being. It gives no effect size, population or period, and the item states none.
The item reports two specific findings of the review (travel satisfaction, life satisfaction). The snapshot holds only bibliographic metadata, so the findings cannot be checked.

The item labels the first source as observational and describes the review's conclusions about life satisfaction as ambiguous. The stored abstract does not use the word observational, and the review snapshot has no content on its conclusions.
